'''''Freesia corymbosa''''' is a perennial, geophyte native to the [[Eastern Cape|Eastern]] and [[Western Cape]].<ref>http://redlist.sanbi.org/species.php?species=1543-6 REDLSIT Sanbi</ref> The species occurs from the Great [[Swartberg]] through the [[Langkloof]] to [[Grahamstown, South Africa|Grahamstown]], [[King William’s Town]] and [[Butterworth, South Africa|Butterworth]]. It also forms part of the [[fynbos]] and [[Albany thickets]] biomes.<ref>http://plantsoftheworldonline.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:437009-1 Plants of the World Online</ref>
